newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-WC Penfold, Penfold Printing warn on profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-WC Penfold, Penfold Printing warn on profit.

text.p: Business supplies group W.C. Penfold Ltd and related printer Penfold Printing Ltd said on Wednesday that profit for the months of November and December would be less than the same period last year.
They cited a deterioration in trading conditions in the retail and printing markets for the lower profit forecast.
But they said they expected to maintain their dividend payouts.
Penfold Printing shares closed untraded but bid at A$1.20, a cent lower than its last trade while W.C. Penfold shares closed untraded but bid at A$2.35, five cents lower than its last trade.
